name: personal-agent-skills
description: Personal agent skills and a curated third-party skill install list.

scripts.skills:list: sh -c 'if ls skills/*/SKILL.md >/dev/null 2>&1; then npx --yes skills add . --list; else echo "No personal skills found under skills/."; fi'
scripts.install:personal: sh -c 'if ls skills/*/SKILL.md >/dev/null 2>&1; then npx --yes skills add . --global --agent cursor --agent claude-code --agent codex --skill "*" --yes; else echo "No personal skills found under skills/; skipping."; fi'
scripts.install:personal:copy: sh -c 'if ls skills/*/SKILL.md >/dev/null 2>&1; then npx --yes skills add . --global --agent cursor --agent claude-code --agent codex --skill "*" --copy --yes; else echo "No personal skills found under skills/; skipping."; fi'
scripts.install:curated: npm run install:curated:superpowers && npm run install:curated:caveman && npm run install:curated:obsidian && npm run install:curated:find-skills && npm run install:curated:emil-design-eng
scripts.install:all: npm run install:personal && npm run install:curated
scripts.install:curated:superpowers: npx --yes skills add obra/superpowers --global --agent cursor --agent claude-code --agent codex --skill '*' --yes
scripts.install:curated:caveman: npx --yes skills add git@github.com:JuliusBrussee/caveman.git --global --agent cursor --agent claude-code --agent codex --skill caveman --skill caveman-commit --skill caveman-compress --skill caveman-help --skill caveman-review --skill compress --yes
scripts.install:curated:obsidian: npx --yes skills add git@github.com:kepano/obsidian-skills.git --global --agent cursor --agent claude-code --agent codex --skill defuddle --skill json-canvas --skill obsidian-bases --skill obsidian-cli --skill obsidian-markdown --yes
scripts.install:curated:find-skills: npx --yes skills add vercel-labs/skills --global --agent cursor --agent claude-code --agent codex --skill find-skills --yes
scripts.install:curated:emil-design-eng: npx --yes skills add emilkowalski/skill --global --agent cursor --agent claude-code --agent codex --skill emil-design-eng --yes
